disposition: In the tested no-host synthetic paired ablation, the uniform start prior lowered late-regime costs relative to M_LRMD_SUI; this does not establish it as the dominant cause of all Amendment-6 loss. Host integration still fails. The all-14-source post-development replay shows no average cost gain over the parent or named deployment comparators; retain P6 only as a scoped synthetic mechanism result.
next_action: Do not claim real transfer or advance P6 as a real-data winner. Any continued method claim requires a changed mechanism and a frozen independent-source evaluation; the present all-14 replay is retrospective and economically unfavorable to P6 against its parent and deployment comparators.
